**nano.md 0.6.0 — Mermaid diagrams in the preview**

- **Diagrams:** ` ```mermaid ` blocks show as diagrams in the preview.
  That covers flowcharts and sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt, pie,
  mindmap and other diagram types, in the light or dark theme.
- **Local drawing:** nano.md draws them itself, on a background thread,
  with no browser and no network.
- **Fallback:** a diagram it can't draw stays a code block. Print still
  shows the source.

**Install:** download the archive for your platform below;
`SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all of them. Binaries are still unsigned, so
SmartScreen and Gatekeeper warn on first launch; the README's Install
section covers both.

**Platforms:** Windows x86_64, macOS arm64 and x86_64 (real `.app`
bundle), Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+, built on ubuntu-22.04).

Full changelog in [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/odysseia06/nanomd/blob/v0.6.0/CHANGELOG.md).
